sections.text_helper: Section 35.5.29 "Timer input XOR function (TIM15 only)" in chapter 35 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1401.
sections.section_content:
The TI1S bit in the TIM_CR2 register, allows the input filter of channel 1 to be connected to
the output of a XOR gate, combining the two input pins tim_ti1 and tim_ti2.
The XOR output can be used with all the timer input functions such as trigger or input
capture. It is useful for measuring the interval between the edges on two input signals, as
shown in Figure533.
[Figure 533. Measuring time interval between edges on 2 signals]
The XORPS control bit selects the position of the XOR gate, as shown in the Figure534 and
Figure535 below, when the TI1S bit is set.
[Figure 534. XOR gate connection with TI1S = 1 and XORPS = 0]
[Figure 535. XOR gate connection with TI1S = 1 and XORPS = 1]
Two control bits TI1INV and TI2INV in the TIM_CR2 register can invert the tim_in1 and
tim_in2 signals prior entering the XOR gate.
The status of the tim_in1 and tim_in2 signals can be software polled using the TI1FS and
TI2FS bits in the TIM_SR register.
